gap: 40px; } .banner-text h2 { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 52px); font-weight: 900; margin-bottom: 16px; } .banner-text h2 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--gold); } .banner-text p { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.7; max-width: 500px; } /* ─── CROCS SECTION ─── */ .croc-card .product-image-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f5e9, #c8e6c9); } /* ─── ACCESSORIES ─── */ .acc-card .product-image-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8eaf6, #c5cae9); } /* ─── GYM SECTION ─── */ .gym-card .product-image-placeholder { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fce4ec, #f8bbd0); } /* ─── FOOTER ─── */ footer { background: var(--black); color: var(--white); padding: 60px; } .footer-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 60px; margin-bottom: 50px; } .footer-brand .logo { font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 38px; letter-spacing: 5px; margin-bottom: 16px; display: block; } .footer-brand .logo span { color: var(--gold); } .footer-brand p { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; max-width: 280px; } .footer-col h4 { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 20px; color: var(--gold); } .footer-col ul { list-style: none; } .footer-col ul li { margin-bottom: 10px; } .footer-col ul a { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); text-decoration: none; font-size: 14px; transition: color .2s; } .footer-col ul a:hover { color: var(--gold); } .footer-bottom { border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); padding-top: 30px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; } .footer-bottom p { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); font-size: 13px; } .social-links { display: flex; gap: 16px; } .social-links a { width: 38px; height: 38px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); text-decoration: none; font-size: 14px; transition: all .2s; } .social-links a:hover { border-color: var(--gold); color: var(--gold); } /* ─── TOAST ─── */ .toast { position: fixed; bottom: 30px; right: 30px; background: var(--black); color: var(--white); padding: 16px 28px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; z-index: 99999; transform: translateY(100px); opacity: 0; transition: all .4s cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.275); border-left: 4px solid var(--gold); } .toast.show { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; } /* ─── RESPONSIVE ─── */ @media (max-width: 900px) { nav { padding: 0 20px; } .nav-links { display: none; } .hero-content { padding: 0 30px; } section { padding: 60px 24px; } .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } .category-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; height: auto; } .cat-tile { height: 150px; } .banner { flex-direction: column; padding: 40px 24px; } .hero-stats { display: none; } } @media (max-width: 560px) { .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 30px; } .hero-title { font-size: 42px; } } /* ─── SCRUB COLORS ─── */ .sw-black { background: #111; } .sw-white { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #ddd; } .sw-pink { background: #f48fb1; } .sw-skyblue { background: #87ceeb; } .sw-darkblue { background: #003366; } .sw-brown { background: #795548; } .sw-navyblue { background: #1a237e; } .sw-mint { background: #98d8c8; } .sw-lavender { background: #ce93d8; } .sw-burgundy { background: #7b1fa2; } .sw-forestgreen { background: #2e7d32; } .sw-gray { background: #9e9e9e; } .sw-teal { background: #00897b; } .sw-coral { background: #ff7043; } .sw-olive { background: #8bc34a; } .sw-red { background: #c62828; } /* ─── LOADING SHIMMER ─── */ .product-grid-loading { display: none; } /* ─── STICKY CART COUNT ─── */ .cart-count { background: var(--gold); color: var(--black); border-radius: 50%; width: 18px; height: 18px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; display: inline-flex; align-items: center;
